sv.title: Nya kaosavrättningen: ”Det fungerar inte, det fungerar inte”
sv.summary: I januari 1996 mördades en diamanthandlare i samband med ett rån i Houston i den amerikanska delstaten Texas. Året därpå dömdes Reinaldo Dennes för mordet. I torsdags, knappt 31 år efter händelsen, skulle Dennes avrättas genom giftinjektion för sitt brott.

en.title: New chaotic execution: "It doesn't work, it doesn't work"
en.summary: In January 1996, a diamond dealer was murdered in connection with a robbery in Houston in the American state of Texas. The following year, Reinaldo Dennes was convicted of the murder. On Thursday, just under 31 years after the incident, Dennes was to be executed by lethal injection for his crime.
